عَيْنٌ صَخْبَةٌ , (K, TA,) with the خ quiescent, (TA,) or ↓ صَخِبَةٌ , (so in a copy of the A,) (tropical:) A spring, or fountain, that is agitated [app. so as to make a confused sound] in estuating. (A, K, TA.) ＝
-A2- And صَخْبَةٌ signifies also The [kind of bead (خَرَزَة), used for captivating, or fascinating, called] عَطْفَة: (TA:) or a bead (خَرَزَة) used [as a charm] in [cases of] love and hatred. (K, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
